tagline: Lloret de Mar's original sports bar since 1986

home.heroTitle: Forty years of matchdays on the biggest terrace in Lloret
home.heroSubtitle: Giant outdoor screen, 15+ TVs and a resident DJ when the whistle blows. Same terrace since 1986.
home.tonightEmpty: Tonight's programme lands on Instagram first. Follow us, or just come down: there's always something on.
home.whyTitle: Built for sport. Made for nights.
home.whySubtitle: Watch the match in the sun, stay for the DJ. That's been the routine here for four decades.

features.screenBody: The biggest outdoor screen in Lloret de Mar, plus 4 terrace TVs and 10 inside. Overlapping fixtures? We show them all.
features.terraceBody: Open day and night, under sail shades and festoon lights. There isn't a bad seat on it.
features.djBody: Full-time resident DJ. When the final whistle goes, the volume comes up.
features.sinceBody: Three generations of regulars can't be wrong. The original sports bar on this coast.

home.heritageTitle: The Queen has kept score here since 1986
home.heritageBody: Queen Vic opened when Maradona lifted the World Cup, and it hasn't missed a season since. Forty years of finals, fry-ups and last-minute winners on the same terrace in Lloret de Mar.
home.stampAlt: Queen Vic's Queen Victoria postage stamp emblem, Lloret de Mar, established 1986
home.finalBody: Tables go fast on match days. Tell us when you're coming and we'll keep you a spot on the terrace.

whatsOn.title: What's on at Queen Vic
whatsOn.subtitle: Every fixture on the giant outdoor screen in Lloret de Mar.
whatsOn.emptyNote: The weekly programme lands on Instagram first. Follow us, or ask us to put your match on.

worldCup.title: Watch World Cup 2026 in Lloret de Mar
worldCup.subtitle: Every match on the giant outdoor screen, with 1,250 m² of terrace to celebrate on. The best World Cup seat in Lloret, same as 1986.
worldCup.p1b: Group stage to final on the biggest outdoor screen in town. Every goal bigger than anywhere else.
worldCup.p2b: Not a word missed from the pundits on the big fixtures.
worldCup.p3b: Queen Vic has been the home of British and Irish fans on this coast for forty years.
worldCup.p4b: When the whistle goes, the resident DJ takes over. World Cup nights here run long past 90 minutes.
worldCup.tip1: The day-by-day programme is published on Instagram during the tournament.
worldCup.tip2: Arrive 30 to 45 minutes early for the big fixtures. The terrace fills fast.
worldCup.tip3: Groups can reserve ahead for knockout nights. Use the reservations page.
worldCup.empty: Fixtures appear as soon as they're confirmed. Check back, or follow us on Instagram.

sportsBar.title: Every seat is a good seat
sportsBar.intro: We can run several fixtures at once. Wherever you sit, you'll have a screen and a cold pint within reach.
sportsBar.s1b: The biggest in Lloret de Mar. Built for World Cup nights and title deciders.
sportsBar.s2b: Four more screens across the terrace, so the sunny seats miss nothing.
sportsBar.s3b: Ten more covering every angle of the bar. Overlapping kick-offs welcome.
sportsBar.showSub: If it matters, it's on. Tell us in advance and we'll do our best to confirm your fixture.

about.title: Forty years on the same terrace
about.p1: Queen Vic opened in 1986, the summer Maradona lifted the World Cup, and it hasn't missed a season since. The original sports bar in Lloret de Mar.
about.p2: What started as a small terrace pub is now 1,250 m² of matchday: a giant outdoor screen, fifteen more around the bar, and a resident DJ who clocks on when the commentators clock off.
about.tl1t: Doors open on the terrace. Maradona wins the World Cup; we pour our first pint.
about.tl2t: The Premier League era. British and Irish regulars make the Vic their home ground.
about.tl3t: The giant outdoor screen arrives. Match days move outside, under the festoon lights.
about.tl4t: Forty years young, and a World Cup summer on the way. See you on the terrace.

reservations.subtitle: Big fixture, stag or hen do, or a proper night out? Tell us when and how many, and we'll sort the rest.
